test_id_conventions.rule: Every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, selects) MUST contain a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Noto Sans Gujarati font in index.html or App.css so Gujarati text renders beautifully with full diacritics.
Ensure language state (Gujarati / English) toggles smoothly across all pages with full translations for UI labels.
Keep the primary branding deep purple (#5B21B6) with clean white rounded cards and colorful module icons as illustrated in user mockup.
Make bottom nav sticky with a prominent floating center purple FAB (+) button for quick actions on mobile viewports.
Ensure member cards feature prominent Call & WhatsApp CTA buttons.
All interactive elements must carry proper data-testid attributes for testing.
